1.consolidated_definition: . Ser imposible, ser inútil, no hay que empeñarse en ello.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
It is impossible, it is futile, do not persist in this.

Alternatively:

1. Be impossible to accomplish or achieve.
2. Be of no use or value; be futile.
3. Do not attempt or try to do something as it will not succeed or be effective.
